Fire Mage

Back to top

Written for the live game, levels 1 to 60, as of the November 12 hotfixes. Numbers are the client's, read with its hotfixes. The talent order is Icy Veins' published one, dated, and it replays legally on the current tree; Wowhead's levelling build is described from its own text. Rotation reasoning that cites WoWSims is a model's, and says so. The level 60 material was published before any raid opened, so none of it rests on a raid log. Blizzard's hotfixes since launch changed one thing for Fire: from November 9, FlamestrikeFlamestrikeLevel 16 · Spell · Fire · Rank 1 of 6Cast3 sec castCost195 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration8 secCalls down a pillar of fire, burning all enemies within the area for 55 to 71 Fire damage and an additional 44 Fire damage over 8 sec. Only one Flamestrike can be active per Mage at a time.'s ground ticks no longer spend an Arcane ConcentrationArcane ConcentrationTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantGives you a 10% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%. proc. Where a spell's tooltip disagrees with the text here, trust the text: tooltips can lag behind a hotfix.

What Fire is for

PyroblastPyroblastLevel 20 · Spell · Fire · Rank 1 of 8Cast6 sec castCost125 ManaRange35 yd rangeDuration12 secHurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 101 to 131 Fire damage and an additional 44 Fire damage over 12 sec. becomes a spell you cast inside a fight. Heating UpHeating UpTalentCastInstantNon-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch reduce the cast time of your next Pyroblast cast within 20 sec by 25%, stacking up to 3 times. Fire Blast grants an additional stack every time it deals damage. cuts its cast time by 25% per stack, so 3 stacks turn 6 seconds into 1.5. Non-periodic Fire crits build stacks, and every Fire BlastFire BlastLevel 6 · Spell · Fire · Rank 1 of 7CastInstantCost40 ManaRange20 yd rangeCooldown8 sec cooldownBlasts the enemy for 27 to 35 Fire damage. adds one. It arrives at 25 at the earliest. Below that Fire is FireballFireballLevel 1 · Spell · Fire · Rank 1 of 12Cast1.5 sec castCost30 ManaRange35 yd rangeDuration4 secHurls a fiery ball that causes 15 to 23 Fire damage and an additional 2 Fire damage over 4 sec., Fire BlastFire BlastLevel 6 · Spell · Fire · Rank 1 of 7CastInstantCost40 ManaRange20 yd rangeCooldown8 sec cooldownBlasts the enemy for 27 to 35 Fire damage. and PyroblastPyroblastLevel 20 · Spell · Fire · Rank 1 of 8Cast6 sec castCost125 ManaRange35 yd rangeDuration12 secHurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 101 to 131 Fire damage and an additional 44 Fire damage over 12 sec. on the pull.

Icy Veins rates Fire 3/5 for levelling, under the heading "Unreliable and Fun"; the score measures solo kill speed, and Wowhead and ClassicWoW.gg publish none. Its reason is mana: without Arcane MeditationArcane MeditationTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantAllows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting., and before Mage ArmorMage ArmorLevel 34 · Spell · Arcane · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost270 ManaDuration1800 secIncreases your resistance to all magic by 5 and allows 50% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 1800 sec. at 34, "you will be stuck drinking after nearly every mob." Its answer is to start in the Arcane tree and move to Fire later.

Wowhead's levelling guide calls Fire "a good but not amazing leveling specialization" and lists what it lacks: Frost's control, Arcane's mana talents, and area damage. What it has is range and single-target damage that needs no ramp.

Forever also cut Fire's baseline damage. FireballFireballLevel 1 · Spell · Fire · Rank 1 of 12Cast1.5 sec castCost30 ManaRange35 yd rangeDuration4 secHurls a fiery ball that causes 15 to 23 Fire damage and an additional 2 Fire damage over 4 sec. rank 12 hits for 425–541 where Classic gave 596–760; ScorchScorchLevel 22 · Spell · Fire · Rank 1 of 7Cast1.5 sec castCost50 ManaRange30 yd rangeScorch the enemy for 38 to 46 Fire damage. and PyroblastPyroblastLevel 20 · Spell · Fire · Rank 1 of 8Cast6 sec castCost125 ManaRange35 yd rangeDuration12 secHurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 101 to 131 Fire damage and an additional 44 Fire damage over 12 sec. were cut similarly, and spell damage counts for more to compensate. Wowhead draws the conclusion: Fire "requires a lot of spell power to get back to its normal baseline Classic WoW damage", so it feels weak until you have a good weapon or dungeon gear.

In dungeons Icy Veins scores it 4.5/5 and warns about threat: a run of crits with IgniteIgniteTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantYour critical strikes from Fire damage spells cause the target to burn for an additional 40% of your spell's damage over 4 sec. "can quickly overtake a Tank in threat." It still calls Fire's area levelling respectable: "The AoE leveling potential of Fire is also respectable."

Your talent points

Two sources publish a levelling build from 10 to 60, and they are different routes. Wowhead starts in Fire. Icy Veins levels in Arcane to 29 and only then moves to Fire. Icy Veins prints its order point by point. Wowhead shows its build as an interactive calculator and describes it in words.

Wowhead's Fire-first route (page dated November 4). The build itself is a calculator on Wowhead's levelling page; its text gives no split and no levels. Stat priority

Both sites that rank Fire's stats do so for level 60, and both call their lists provisional.

  1. Hit, to 17% against a raid boss. Icy Veins gives 4% as the figure against a same-level target
  2. Spell Power, including Fire damage
  3. Critical strike: IgniteIgniteTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantYour critical strikes from Fire damage spells cause the target to burn for an additional 40% of your spell's damage over 4 sec., Heating UpHeating UpTalentCastInstantNon-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch reduce the cast time of your next Pyroblast cast within 20 sec by 25%, stacking up to 3 times. This effect lasts until you have caused 3 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells. all run on it
  4. Intellect. Wowhead places Spell Piercing and Haste above it, and says Spell Piercing's worth at 60 is not yet confirmed
  5. Spirit
  6. MP5 (Icy Veins) or Stamina (Wowhead) last

Below 60, crit is limited by what the gear offers rather than by where it ranks. Icy Veins' levelling guide argues for Spirit on the way up if you have Arcane MeditationArcane MeditationTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantAllows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.: time not spent drinking is worth more than a little spell damage. That is its judgement, not a measured figure.

Fire Blast grants an additional stack every time it deals damage. is new and it changes the spec (ours). Blizzard renamed it from Hot Streak, "since it is no longer dependent on having a 'streak'." Its deep dive calls it "Forever's variation on the ideas found in the Hot Streak talent", and older pages may still use that name. The buff lasts 20 seconds, so a 15 printed elsewhere is out of date.
